description:
Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。


[0.3.2] - 2026-08-05
🚀 新功能
- 桌面端与 Web 端的下载任务现已互通：可在多台设备间协同执行任务，状态实时同步。
- 设置页新增「环境诊断」(Doctor)：一键自检本地服务、协议关联、日志目录等状态，支持一键修复并复制诊断报告。
- 下载完成后若源文件被移动或删除，可选择自动清除该任务记录；非 BitTorrent 任务支持一键清空产物、从零重新下载；任务管理栏支持批量清理失效任务。
- 任务列表新增「复制文件」到系统剪贴板，可直接粘贴到文件管理器；文件丢失状态与清理操作现已跨设备同步。
- 分类目录管理支持一键应用默认下载目录下的同名子目录（或一键清除），Web 端新建下载也按此规则保存文件，与桌面端行为一致。
- RSS 条目标题过长被省略号截断时，鼠标悬浮即可查看完整标题，Web 端同步支持。
- 本机服务新增跨域访问开关（默认关闭）与局域网访问地址选择，方便第三方站点探测本机下载服务、或在局域网内访问。
- 任务列表的图标按钮新增悬浮说明气泡，暂停/继续/删除等操作意图更清晰。
🐛 问题修复
- 修复设置页部分输入框（自定义 User-Agent、主题色、文件管理器命令、API 端口/Token 等）未按回车确认就切换页面或最小化窗口时，编辑内容会丢失的问题；移动端输入面板也改为关闭即保存。
- 修复 Linux 部分桌面环境（如 GNOME）下托盘图标可能不显示或丢失的问题。
- 修复默认下载目录未正确读取系统当前设置（如已手动迁移下载文件夹）的问题，现在会按操作系统实际配置解析。
- 修复部分服务器（如腾讯云 COS）返回带引号的 Content-Disposition 文件名时，下载文件名末尾出现多余下划线的问题。
[0.3.2] - 2026-08-05
🚀 Features
- Desktop and Web downloads are now connected: tasks can be executed and tracked across multiple devices with real-time status sync.
- Added a "Doctor" diagnostics panel in Settings: self-checks the local service, protocol association, and log directory, with one-click repair and a copyable diagnostic report.
- When a completed task's file is moved or deleted, you can choose to auto-clear its record; non-BitTorrent tasks can be restarted from scratch, clearing old artifacts. The task manager bar now supports bulk cleanup of tasks with missing files.
- Added "Copy File" to the system clipboard from the task list, ready to paste into a file manager; missing-file status and cleanup now sync across devices.
- Category folders can now be applied or cleared with one click under the default download directory; new downloads on Web follow the same category rules as desktop.
- Long RSS item titles that get truncated with an ellipsis now show the full text on hover, on both desktop and Web.
- Added a CORS exemption toggle (off by default) and a LAN address picker for the local service, making it easier for third-party sites to detect the local service (e.g. aria2 compatibility) or access it over the local network.
- Icon-only action buttons in the task list now show hover tooltips, making actions like pause/resume/delete clearer.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed several Settings inputs (custom User-Agent, theme color, file manager command, API port/token, etc.) losing edits when you switched pages or minimized the window without pressing Enter; mobile input sheets now also save on close.
- Fixed the tray icon sometimes failing to appear or disappearing on some Linux desktop environments (e.g. GNOME).
- Fixed the default download directory not reflecting the OS's actual current setting (e.g. after manually relocating the Downloads folder); it now resolves via the system API.
- Fixed a trailing underscore appearing in downloaded filenames when some servers (e.g. Tencent Cloud COS) return a quoted Content-Disposition filename.
